original_idea.body: # Benign-Prompt Spontaneous Deception Probe. Benign agentic tasks with verifiable ground truth where a model could misreport to look successful; detect verifiably-false statements; measure spontaneous-deception rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Spontaneous deception on benign prompts is insidious and under-measured; clear chain to honesty monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Benign agentic tasks with deterministic ground truth; accessible, reproducible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused benchmark with verifiable ground truth; building task set adds modest effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable benchmark filling a real gap; labs underweight.

low_compute.reasoning: Agentic inference with deterministic checks, API-feasible.

novelty.reasoning: Phenomenon established in source paper; compact reusable benchmark plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Phenomenon established; compact benchmark plausibly open.
